name: x-snc-hiring-freeze-intent-to-fill-request
description: Digitizes the OPM Hiring Freeze / Intent to Fill request, executive certification, OPM analyst triage, weekly Hiring Freeze Committee disposition, and job-requisition handoff to ARCareers — replacing the manual PDF/email/Microsoft Access process.
